I see - at line 1771, `xmlFreeDoc(ctxt->incTab[nr]->doc)` is called when `count <= 1`. This frees the document that was loaded for the XInclude. But the nodes from that document may have been moved into the main document tree (via `xmlXIncludeIncludeNode`), and those nodes still reference the freed document's namespace declarations. Let me look at how the included nodes are loaded and how namespaces are handled.

Let me look at `xmlXIncludeLoadNode` more fully and understand the flow.
